4.Description: A banner bearing the crest of House Rayne. A symbol of their indomitable spirit.

5.Description: A sharp spear that can cast natural magic. Ideal for any defender of the forest.

9.Description: A weapon so named because anything is weak against it.

14.Description: A matching pair of obsidian daggers, bringing eternal rest to many foes.

16.Description: A gift that fell from the sky. Rains destruction in the same way.

20.Description: A holy artifact imbued with radiant essence.

25.Description: A cruel pair of blades, especially effective against other undead.

26.Description: The axes used by Khasos to fell a Mauler chieftain in ritual combat.

27.Description: A cursed orb containing a trapped spirit. Inspires dread in those who look upon it.

28.Description: An ethereal ring of light capable of driving away nightmares.

32.Description: The royal symbol of a fallen king. Imbued with spite at the treachery he suffered.

33.Description: A mysterious, cursed book filled with arcane knowledge and perhaps its own will.

34.Description: A pair of reliable old blasters. Good for getting into and out of sticky situations.

35.Description: A crossbow, accurate and light. Perfect for a skulking kill or cunning ambush.

36.Description: A mask that acts as a window to another world.

37.Description: An enchanted casket containing a horde of malicious spirits.

38.Description: A cavalry spear crafted from the jaw of a demon lord. Inflicts wicked wounds.

39.Description: Cruel and graceless. Crafted for butchery and slaughter.

41.Description: A bow housing a greedy spirit now tormented by a desperate hunger.

42.Description: Strange carved designs that glow with ancient power.

43.Description: Heavy vambraces well suited to a wild and brutish fighting style.

44.Description: A blessed shield that remains unscathed after a hundred battles.

45.Description: Swift, light, and sharp. Always seems to find the right spot.

46.Description: A fearsome weapon with the power of crashing waves.

47.Description: Ideal arms for a lethal mix of flurried offense and lightning quick defense.

48.Description: Elegant weapons and elemental conduits. Can project and direct wind.

49.Description: A cruel, necrotic weapon that causes festering wounds nearly impossible to heal.

50.Description: A pair of tower shields that when brought together form an unbreakable wall.

51.Description: A large scepter with a radiant design symbolizing absolute power.

52.Description: A bell that seems to bring good fortune with its cheerful ring.

54.Description: A crystal that is able to absorb fire. This jewel is sometimes unable to contain the power held within, resulting in a very deadly aftermath.

55.Description: A set of shining patas intended to cleanse the realm of the unworthy.

56.Description: Twisted armor that represents the very evil it protects.

57.Description: Made from an incredibly hard substance, this hammer can bring down a fortress.

58.Description: A strange creation. As much a tool for reaping as a weapon for fighting.

59.Description: A whip, the touch of which enslaves its victims. The tool of a cruel master.

60.Description: As tall as a person, this longbow requires great strength and accuracy to be used efficiently. The bow gets its name due to the high velocity of its arrows, which are said to be as fast as a shooting star.

61.Description: An extraordinary broom which has a mind of its own, brought to life by Rosaline.

62.Description: A pair of headdresses that allow an uncanny connection between the wearers.

63.Description: A sharp and deadly pair of blades that are laced with a powerful, unknown substance. These blades have been used to augment countless unwilling test subjects.

64.Description: An hourglass that has the skill to change the flow of time, allowing for its holder to go back or forth in time as they please. This hourglass is said to be the embodiment of Zolrath's wretched soul.

196.Description: 小巧而锋利的小刀，刀刃上沾染着成分未知的炼金毒液，那些疯狂的炼金术师用它们来施展骇人听闻的人体改造手术。(不用翻译)

65.Description: A staff gifted to Lorsan by the wise old sage, Arden. Although simple and unadorned, this staff is abound with a great natural power.

66.Description: A divine book that contains prayers used to exorcise demonic spirits and drive away evil.

67.Description: The key to the void. This unearthly object is capable of opening doors to dark, unknown planes of existence.

68.Description: Crafted out of sawtooth oak from the dark forest, this barrel possesses unique magical attributes that makes its contents all the more tasty.

69.Description: Crafted by the celestial carpenter, Ansiel, this heavenly timepiece has the skill to manipulate the flow of time and even stop it.

70.Description: Two vicious-looking blades that have been the demise of many unfortunate gladiators. Crafted to perfection, they were built with only one intention in mind, death.

71.Description: A weapon built with the prime purpose of impaling its victims, it contains a powerful chemical agent that is capable of turning the gentlest of souls into unbridled killing machines.

72.Description: A beautifully crafted, yet deadly knife that is as sophisticated as its owner. Able to slice through all types of meat with ease, few people are worthy of owning such a tool.

73.Description: A powerful and extremely rare stone that was forged within the Solaran Furnace. The flame that burns within it can never be extinguished.

74.Description: Crafted by the finest Wilder weaponsmith and enchanted by the most powerful enchanter in Esperia, this rare two-headed spear is brimming with the powerful arcane forces of the forest. Only the most proficient of warriors are capable of utilizing such perfection.

75.Description: It had been her father's, and it was her most prized possession. The weapon that he had given her was more than just a gift. With it came the weight of her vow to carry out her father's last wish.

76.Description: Frozen in perpetuity, this object emanates a coldness that is able to cut through bone and steel.

77.Description: One wonders how a small Durri is able to wreak such havoc. The answer: The Ivory Piercer. Crafted from the horns of a powerful Iron-jaw, this weapon is light but also extremely durable. You don't want to be on the wrong end of this powerful weapon.

78.Description: The legendary sword of King Arthur that was returned to him by the Lady of the Lake. It possesses an immense power that can only be wielded by The One True King.

80.Description: Woven together with a magical material, this cloak is more powerful than it appears. Wearing it allows one to forge a powerful connection with the forest's flora.

83.Description: A powerful scepter that symbolizes wisdom and power. Only the true Mauler chieftain may wield it.

84.Description: A deceptively heavy and powerful rod that can grow on command. It is said to be capable of injuring and killing almost all beings.

85.Description: Two vicious tools used exclusively to butcher and maim victims that exist as symbol of Mezoth's depravity. It is said many poor souls bear the scars of Mezoth's wrath on their bodies.

86.Description: Ukyo Tachibana's self-crafted, unnamed sword. Simple and unadorned. Shinmusou Ittou Ryu.

87.Description: Hefty and colossal, this horn of war has been left scarred by the many battles it was used in. Once again its call shall be heard, ushering in a new era of war.

88.Description: A deadly blade that slices through flesh like a hot knife through butter.

89.Description: A magical broomstick that was crafted by the celestial craftsman Ansiel out of a special and rare wood. This unique broomstick is able to bring flowers to blossom and can fly to lofty heights if needed.

90.Description: A small soft-toy that goes by the name "Stitchy", stitched together by Daimon's mother with the leftover parts of fabric from her tailor shop. Infused with a soul, Stitchy never leaves his owner's side, and now acts as his guardian protector.

91.Description: Trapped by a crown of thorns, even in death, the wearer is humiliated by what it symbolizes. The crown acts as a constant reminder of the fell deeds perpetrated by its wearer, who even in death, is doomed to wear it for an eternity.

92.Description: Through studying pages from Altair's codex, Leonardo da Vinci was able to provide Ezio an upgraded Hidden Blade. As a symbol of the Assassin, Ezio will use the Hidden Blade until the end of his career.

93.Description: Born out of hatred and vengeance, the Dark Star encompasses a burning power like none other. The most peculiar observation about this powerful weapon is, that its hilt bears the symbol of an ancient temple cleric, from many millennia ago.

94.Description: A verdant branch plucked from an ancient and arcane tree, located deep within the heartlands of Wilder territories. Only those whose veins course with the forest's blood may wield it.

95.Description: Sand flows and swirls around the hilt of this mysterious dagger, enabling the wielder to control time, reversing the flow. However, if misused, it will lead to great disaster.

96.Description: An illustrious spear consisting of heavenly lightning. Its frightening heat and power is able to turn enemies into ashes in an instance.

97.Description: Tabula Smaragdina, Albedo's creator, secretly equipped her with a world-class item - Ginnungagap. It has devastating destructive power when used on objects. When wielded in Albedo's hand, it appears as a wand, with a black floating sphere at the top end.

98.Description: The Great Tomb of Nazaricks inhabitants created and dedicated this powerful relic staff to their beloved Overlord, Ainz Ooal Gown. Seven serpents coil around the magic staff, their expressions pained as they struggle to contain the power of the gemstones in their mouths, each one concealing world quality artifact power. Not only does the staff represent the ultimate power of Nazaricks' ruler, but also holds within it the most precious memories of Ainz Ooal Gown and his Guildmates.

99.Description: The strongest thing in the world is neither magic nor might, it is deception.

102.Description: The Frozen Mother's bone-piercing spear, forged in a blazing furnace as hot as her soul.

103.Description: Model 53 Multi-Function Hand Cannon and Model 82 Grenade Launcher, designed with destruction in mind, the two complement one another perfectly.

104.Description: A symbol with which Respen was born with that allows him to resonate with the wind, and sense its will.

105.Description: A mask forged out of pure gold. Wearing it is to give up all emotion, to remove all distractions from one's mind, to become the arbiter of justice and order.

106.Description: A slingshot that Raku crafted from a branch of a tree found within the Bastion of the Elements. It allows Raku to hit far-away targets.

107.Description: This gorgeous multicolored conch is a testament to Princess Peggy's friendship with Raku, and is also used to call forth her royal guards.

108.Description: A remnant of the destroyed Zohra Nebula, it is as stunningly beautiful as it is powerful. When in the hands of a god, the Heart of Zohra can be used to generate powerful Cosmic Fields.

109.Description: A unique seashell which has a smell of betrayal still lingering on it, which never leaves Desira's person. Carved on the shell is the name of the person who betrayed her. Each time Desira blows the shell signifies that impending death is soon to be upon her enemies.

110.Description: A huge shotgun Walker had made in the Land of the Exiles, it has all the characteristics of a crazed bull. The special bullets filled with a potent gun powder roar as they're fired, emitting a powerful shockwave and heavy impact reminiscent of a charging bull.

111.Description: Crafted from the bones of a long-deceased shadow mastiff, this cane is the pure embodiment of evil. The cane itself is said to be possessed by the entrapped soul of this vicious creature. Shadow mastiffs are known for their loyalty, and the vicious soul within this cane is eagerly awaiting its master's beckoning.

112.Description: Legend says that the denizens of Britain believe this staff to have healing properties. Its brilliance has been said to give divine enlightenment to those who gaze upon it long enough. Given that the staff belongs to the great wizard, Merlin, there seems to be some evidence to substantiate these claims.

113.Description: Brimming with the fiery elemental energy, it converts the wearer's blood into a blazing flame.

114.Description: An energy core developed by Ansiel, the Celestial crafter, which he placed inside the stone body he had built for Titus in order to power his body. The Mountain Star originates from the mountains, and is as heavy as it is powerful. The Mountain Star has the power to protect the innocent, but also wreak devastation on those who oppose the light.

115.Description: With the help of the infamous scientist, Silas, bloody thirsty Hodgkin had both of his arms augmented with powerful hand-cannons that contain a lethal substance. Not only can the Soul Devourers consume souls, they are also capable of letting loose a deadly barrage of firepower upon Hodgkin's enemies.

116.Description: A highly-valued item amongst the Secret Society of the Crow's members. It possesses knowledge about every type of dark magic within the realm, and is easily bent to its holder's will.

117.Description: Red, lidless eyes covering Zikis' demonic wings. When the wings are spread out in mid-flight, they can easily turn a person insane. The rapid opening and closing of the red eyes is enough to cause Zikis' hapless victim to lose control of their inhibitions.

118.Description: An energy core composed of desert sand that is the embodiment of Granit's inner restlessness. It possesses the power to petrify everything.

119.Description: Magical tools that are the combination of art and magic. Composed of two parts, a brush and paper, which Leonardo uses most frequently during his studies. The brush bends to the wishes of the one holding it, and has the power to paint any color, while the paper can turn the images drawn upon into real life objects.

120.Description: After years of training, Mishka was able to keep certain parts of her body in bear form all year round. These sharp talons are her most powerful weapon.

121.Description: An unusual looking monolith that is said to have been crafted by the godly crafter Ansiel himself, which brims with the knowledge he has bestowed unto it.

122.Description: A blade that Treznor has carried into battle many times. Its exterior is laden with hundreds of deeply grooved scars, yet it still possesses a power great enough to shred Treznor's enemies into thousands of unrecognizable pieces.

123.Description: The earliest history of bone flute can be traced back to the formation of the Bone Glades. The peculiar mewling sound that the bone flute makes is said to be connected with the land, which allows the one who plays it to become the master of creatures that crawl across the land.

125.Description: Specially crafted vambraces that have grooves etched into the metal, allowing Framton to better control his flames and wreak even more destruction on his unfortunate foes.

124.Description: A core stone formed by the coalescence of flame at the heart of the Earth, it contains pure Solaris Flare. The radiance of the sun overflows from it.

126.Description: A lantern made from Phoenix Flowers, it brims with the fiery power of the Solaris Flare. It has the skill to ward off evil, and bring hope into people's hearts.

127.Description: The stabilizer acts as a sort of magical reservoir for Scarlet, allowing her to regulate the powerful dark magic which flows through her, which was formed when she razed the Violet Orphanage to the ground. The dark forces within Scarlet rage through her like a surging river, the malice unbridled, the rage overflowing. Thus, It is with the use of this arcane core that Scarlet is able to channel her dark energy, and use it as she so wishes.

128.Description: This staff full of mysterious magic is Melusina's main source of power, and is what she uses to manipulate and bend things to her will. Melusina uses this staff to summon mystical objects, and to communicate with animals.

129.Description: Fane plucked this bone hook from inside a Ya. It was in this way he came to learn of the differences between human and Ya skeletal structures. Unfortunately, his inexperience lead to a unfortunate outcome, with his Ya specimen soon breathing its last breath. The moment the Ya perished, Fane found himself awash with a great sense of joy, thus he decided to keep the object as a part of his collection. The Bone Hook is coincidentally the torture instrument most feared by the condemned.

130.Description: Forged from infernal flames, this shoulder armor has a twisted and frightening shape that is a representation of true nightmares. The sharp spikes upon the armor stand ready, waiting to tear all mortal will to shreds.

131.Description: A horn gifted by Skriath. Having spent all its life on the arid dunes, its once sparkling metal has been inevitably dulled by the harsh desert winds. It shares a likeness with its owner, Alaro, it's not much to look at, but it can still deliver a message across a great distance.

132.Description: A bow and arrows formed from the condensed residual energy of the Zohra Nebula. The light and power of past stars is contained within, and only in divine hands may its true power be awakened.

133.Description: Provided to Oku by a group known as Thorned Vengeance, the two armored beetles were trained by insect whisperers, and follow Oku into every battle. When attached to Oku's arms, they act as formidable armor, and greatly enhance the destructiveness of Oku's punches.

134.Description: Prince Lester's light one-handed sword. After being imbued with the elemental power of wind, it is as light and sharp as the wind itself. Finding an enemy's vulnerability has never been easier.

135.Description: A ring adorned with lethally sharp blades. It was once used to torture Vyloris, but after extricating herself from her plight, she now uses it to inflict pain on others. Used with precision, it can purposely miss its victim's vital organs, endlessly prolonging their torment.

136.Description: A cane made of pure gold. The thistles and thorns covering it are filled with the blood of slaves, which intertwine as they ascend to the gold rose situated on top. When protection is betrayed, all that remains beneath the rose is death and sin.

137.Description: Windcleavers were once the standard blades used by the Mauler tribes, with this particular blade having accompanied Anasta through innumerable battles. As her prowess in combat grew ever more refined, so did the ever-growing number of scars on her Windcleaver. Her Windcleaver has needed tending to multiple times over its lifetime. Every time that the blade was reforged, a special type of mineral was added into during the smelting process, filling in old battle scars with renewed vigor. The desert's wind, having slowly dulled the blade's sharpness over the years, has slowly transformed it into something else. But just like its owner, it is firm and resolute, and abounding with destructive power.

138.Description: The culmination of fear, derived from the Bloody Priesthood's countless victims just before they met their perilous end, which now serves Queen Kalene as her mount. It gnaws on lost spirits, and sullies itself in the fresh blood of its fallen victims. It is loyal to no one else but its queen.

139.Description: The blade that has accompanied Brutus in countless battles. It was broken in a fierce battle, but the Earth Elemental has reconstructed the blade, imbuing it with the power of mountains.

140.Description: Joan of Arc's original standard has been lost on the other side of the dimension. This new one was made after arriving Esperia in the hope of defeating Hypogeans. Blessed by the Temple of Light, the standard preserves the Mark of Iris found in Joan of Arc's hometown.

141.Description: A crafty spear that can be used as is or disassembled into a shaft and a spearhead and used separately. Eorin has implanted special spores into this weapon which can apply Poisonous Mushroom and Vine Fern to enemies in combat, making them suffer greatly.

142.Description: An Artifact forged by Tarnos with his Celestial blood. It can change form at will, and is both an indestructible blade and a catalyst for wielding magic. Physical weapons are unable to channel the power of the Atoner. Only Tarnos' own boiling blood can carry his will of revenge.

143.Description: A staff formed from the condensed power of water, shaped like a crescent moon, and flowing with radiance. It greatly increases water affinity, allowing Solise to summon Water Spirits as she does Floral Specters.

144.Description: A medallion Geralt received when he left Kaer Morhen. It marks his identity as a witcher of the School of the Wolf. The badge vibrates in the presence of magic or monsters. In most cases when this happens, it means the witcher had better grab his sword.

145.Description: Yennefer's favorite necklace, which shines when she is casting a spell. It is a dazzling glow possessed only by a sorceress.

146.Description: Originally a chain used for restraining Mauler slaves and from which the Chimera freed themselves after they were born. The beast kept it as a reminder of the painful humiliation they had endured and not to show any mercy for their enemies.

147.Description: A lush, green sprig formed of the power of the Wood Element. New shoots are always growing from its tip.

148.Description: The pike brings together and balances the power of necromancy and the Wood Element. It can inflict wounds that are hard to heal on enemies while repairing itself, keeping its tip constantly sharp.

149.Description: A staff inlaid with obsidian which serves as its core energy. It is considered a symbol of the self-sacrifice of the Cursebearers. They are able to keep the guardian obelisk functioning through the obsidian, a medium that suppresses the curse of the Ancient Sphere. It is only in the hands of the Cursebearers that the Staff of Sacrifice can exert amazing power.

150.Description: A holy tome gifted to Palmer when he was young. It contains the teachings of the Divine Light, from which he has gleaned lifetimes' worth of knowledge and guidance. It is of his most treasured companions in his quest to spread the Divine Light's benevolence.

151.Description: This sword has passed through successive Gods of War, molded by each of their spirits. Many Gods of War have fallen, but the sword's splendor has never been tarnished. When a worthy wielder appears and takes up the sword, they shall become the God of War.

152.Description: Mulan's sword from her hometown. It is no precious treasure, but it is her long-time companion and one of her most trusted partners.

153.Description: Once a Staff of Light, it is enveloped in the Divine Light. Now the sacred item also wields the power of flames after being endowed by the fire element.

154.Description: Grappling hook specially made by Tamrus' foster parents for him. Although it can't be described as elegant, it is very durable. His parents put their warmth and love into making it, so for Tamrus, this is the best grappling hook ever made. When used properly, it can deal considerable damage and be used to continuously attack even under complex conditions. Its only drawback is that it demands a higher skill level from the wielder.

155.Description: A cannon that bewitches the soul and devours one's humanity like ravenous locusts, giving birth to a Hypogean.

156.Description: After being resurrected as a Graveborn, Edwin received this weapon from Quaedam. Formed of Graveborn hatred, this whip sword is sharp as a dragon's claw and twice as unpredictable, making it the perfect complement to Edwin's treachery.

157.Description: A core stone belonging to the Obsidian Finches that once contained the Solaris Flare. When Maetria was seriously wounded, the stone shattered and the Solaris Flare within died away. The Hypogeans have since imbued it with new power. An intense, fiendish flame now burns brightly within the stone.

158.Description: Once belonging to Leah, it is the only object that Crassio holds dear from his past.

159.Description: This green crystal pendant signifies the contract between Emilia and Puck. Emilia always wears it and never takes it off. As the Great Spirit of Fire, Puck exists only for Emilia.

160.Description: A spiked iron ball that allows Rem to take full advantage of her combat skills. This portable weapon is good for both offense and defense, and can decimate anyone it strikes in a battle.

161.Description: Sharp blades formed out of pure Divine Light, with slashes swift and sharp as light. All evil melts away in its sacred beams.

162.Description: A new Burst Hammer forged by Ginneas himself using the latest techniques and smelting processes of the dwarves of Haltor. It is more flexible to wield than its previous iteration.

163.Description: A magical staff the Godly Crafter, Ansiel, forged for Daemia, to help her wield the power of summer. But she was not pleased with the final product, so she ornamented it with tons of flowers in full bloom.

164.Description: It contains the glory of the stars, recording the mysteries of the universe. If you are peeped on with this instrument, do not panic!

165.Description: A scepter glowing with the light of the Dark Star. After Safiya controlled fragments of the Dark Star, it absorbed the power of the Void Realm and transformed into the appearance of the Star Destroyer.

166.Description: From its previous role as a creator of happiness, the carving knife has transformed into a somber tool for scraping and chiseling skeletal remains. Each time it is used, it infuses the work with Graveborn magic.

167.Description: Bells unique to the Wyrmriders and worn by each of them since young to control the Wyrmcrawler. To the ears of ordinary people, the bells' rings are just a crisp pleasing sound, but the Wyrmcrawler hear them as commands from their masters.

168.Description: A giant axe forged by the Hypogeans, with engraved magical runes that can absorb an enemy's power and transfer it to its wielder.

169.Description: A wand carried by Liberta. It is said to have been tailored by the gods for Liberta, based on the blueprint of the Scales of Benevolence designed by Ansiel the Celestial Craftsman.

170.Description: A long bow formed by nebulas summoned by Lyca, which contains the true power of the stars. Every time it is pulled, rays of hope shimmer throughout.

171.Description: "The Thousand Sail Fleet belongs to the Imperial Royal Navy, with over 200 triple-masted warships. The flagship of the fleet, Torch Bearer, is a huge battleship with 150 cannons. It's a truly sea-moving fortress."

172.Description: A gift from a blacksmith to his benefactor. A mechanism hidden on the bow allows its user to freely switch between different bow lengths as needed. It is a superbly practical yet exquisite weapon.

173.Description: To save Daimon, Shemira was engulfed by tortured souls. After Shemira helped them with their revenge, they resided peacefully in the Cursed Soulchain, keeping Shemira company.

174.Description: The distinctive chime of this bewitching bell recites the Doctrine of Death. Deacons of the Chiming Order have used it secretly to gain followers in the empire.

175.Description: A bass forged from converging Hypogean flames that engulfs everyone who calls it a guitar.

210.Description: A divine-class magical artifact gifted to Shalltear by Peroroncino, her creator. Once equipped, it absorbs incoming damage and recovers the wearer's strength.

213.Description: This mirror is a mysterious relic handed down through generations of Mira's ancestors, and only those of her bloodline can unlock its hidden powers to gain formidable arcane skills.

217.Description: Woven from the roots of the second-generation clones of the world tree, Marcille's staff has a life of its own. Ambrosia is a crucial tool for focusing Marcille's magical powers, therefore, she treasures it as an indispensable item for her magic.

218.Description: Kensuke was originally a sword wielded by a Living Armor, but after battle, it's now wielded by Laios. The Living Armor still resides within it, so Kensuke can detect the presence of other monsters, but tends to flee when encountering powerful ones.

225.Description: A lightweight yet razor-sharp one-handed sword. Its edge channels Cha Hae-in's mana, each masterful swing unleashing strikes as elegant as they are deadly.

224.Description: A dagger obtained after defeating Kasaka, the serpent-like monster. Razor-sharp and laced with venom, it pierces through armor with deadly precision.

227.Description: A fishing rod custom-made by Talimar herself. Simple in appearance yet surprisingly effective, it functions as both fishing rod and harpoon. Perfectly crafted in material, durability, and feel, this fishing rod has accompanied Talimar from her desert homeland to the vast ocean. Every scuff and scratch it bears tells the story of her journey and growth.

230.Description: With this sacred circlet, Selene senses the creatures of the night. Forged not of mortal steel, nor bearing a blade, it channels moonlight into a keen edge that severs fear from the heart. Like a whisper in a dream, it carries silent prayers to the ears of the gods, and casts a gentle light into the darkest corners of destiny.

236.Description: The cape Saitama wears when he's doing hero stuff.

237.Description: The black dress Terrible Tornado always wears.

242.Description: The most delectable vintage in the world is brewed from a heart pounding with fear.

247.Description: It once belonged to a master of an old play, controlling the fates of countless puppets, until one day it fell into the hands of someone who truly saw through this play.

251.Description: An ancient, sacred shield that embodies the oaths of the Acropolis and the majesty of battle. All who glimpse its radiance will hear a pending judgement.

252.Description: A serpentine whip woven from Medusa's snaked hair and her petrifying curses. Wherever its shadow strikes, all is turned to cold, gray stone—breath, flesh, and fear alike.

256.Description: A standard weapon used by Kafka Hibino as a member of the Defense Force.

257.Description: Kikoru Shinomiya's exclusive weapon. The marks across her axe tell the story of every battle she has fought against Kaiju.

1126.Description: Forged from infernal flames, this shoulder armor has a twisted and frightening shape that is a representation of true nightmares. The sharp spikes upon the armor stand ready, waiting to tear all mortal will to shreds.
